framing.decision: Before relying on a dynaflows change, flag each repository whose setup or agent interaction it reaches, so the change is reviewed or addressed for that repository first
framing.unit_of_judgment: one revision range of oh-mi-pi-config crossed with one repository record and its mode
framing.action: a flag keeps the restart review task and refuses Git writes until it is acknowledged
framing.costs: a miss (an impacting change relied on unreviewed) costs more than a false flag (an extra review)
framing.wiring: lib/session-rails.ts restart review, enforced from the start: yes keeps the review task and its Git-write gate; no stores the revision and notifies the owner; a judge failure keeps the review task

scoring.command: infisical run --projectId <dev project> --env dev -- bun <scorer> (omp 19.0.1 library judge)
scoring.runs: omp 19.0.1 library judge (Settings overlay modelRoles.judge typesafe/jev-1.14.0, retry.fallbackChains.judge []; TYPESAFE_API_KEY from Infisical dev via infisical run), one judge() call per case, retries 2, concurrency 8, 2026-11-21; every answer reported model typesafe/jev-1.14.0; re-scored after the owner's T2 ruling

impact.rule: P(impact) >= threshold flags the repository for review

measured_band.note: measurement record only: without a fallback judge a band cannot decide
measured_band.between: escalate: the owner or a reviewing agent decides
measured_band.fallback: owner or reviewing agent; not run on the cases, so cascade figures assume the fallback is right
measured_band.chosen_on: dev only: the narrowest band with no dev positive at or below no_at_most and no dev negative at or above yes_at_least

minimums.reason: framing defaults; recall raised to 0.9 because a miss costs more

label_set.split: by unit (extension commit): the 8 units with the lowest sha256(head) are test
label_set.provenance: agent_reviewed: innovation-council first pass (blind to scores; innovation-challenger and experiment-peer labelled independently, the council reconciled), claude as final arbiter agreeing on all 84; owner may override
label_set.rebuild: 2026-11-21: the 31 minimal-stratum cases were dropped (the rail judges structured repositories only) and each record gate was rebuilt in the current schema: dynaflows removed; the oh-mi-pi-config record holds the nuc-config mergePolicies entry the cutover adds. Labels unchanged.
label_set.owner_rulings: 2026-11-21: tie-break T2 'judge as if applied today' confirmed. EI049 carries provenance 'owner ruling 2026-11-21: T2' (label 0 unchanged, rule T2). EI050 and EI051, the minimal-mode pair T2 would turn 1 -> 0, left the set with the minimal stratum; no other case in the set turns on T2

results.calibration: Not recomputed after the 2026-11-21 re-score; gates read raw scores; probabilities are not shown as confidence.

test_misses.EI082: auto-no below the band; not re-analysed after the re-score
